北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感 -2℃ 很冷哦，注意添衣保暖，多喝水！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels like -2℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪 风力 3级，体感 -3℃，外出要多穿点，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, a chilly -3℃ with 3-level wind. Bundle up to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海微冷，体感 -1℃。出门记得多加件衣服哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cool, feels like -1℃. Remember to layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 11℃。早晚温差大，别忘了带件外套。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 11℃. Mind the temperature changes, bring a jacket.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 15℃。天气舒适，但也要注意早晚保暖哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Pleasant day, but keep warm in the morning and evening.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 风力 3级，体感 0℃。寒风刺骨，请您务必穿暖和。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou, 3-level wind makes it feel like 0℃. It's chilly, please dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -1℃，湿度 18%。很干，防寒保湿很重要哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -1℃ and 18% humidity. It's dry, so stay warm and hydrated!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 77%。微冷潮湿，注意防潮和保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and humid at 77%. It's damp and cool, stay warm and mindful of moisture.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 5℃。出门穿暖点，小心昼夜温差。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 5℃. Dress warmly, watch for temperature changes between day and night.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，湿度仅 7%！请多饮水，注意补水保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, but humidity is only 7%! Please drink plenty of water and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度 55%。出门注意保暖，带伞以防万一。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 55% humid. Stay warm and carry an umbrella just in case.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 体感 -14℃，风力 3级。请全副武装，防寒防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -14℃ with 3-level wind. Bundle up completely to brave the cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 体感 -12℃，风力 3级。务必做好防寒，别冻着了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -12℃ with 3-level wind. Take full precautions against the cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，湿度 66%。空气湿润微凉，注意添衣别感冒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and 66% humid. Air is damp and cool, add layers to avoid a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 风力 3级，体感 8℃。风有点大，出门记得防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen with 3-level wind, feels like 8℃. It's breezy, stay warm and shielded from wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛 体感 -5℃，风力 3级。又冷又干，穿厚点，记得补水。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -5℃ with 3-level wind. It's cold and dry, dress warmly and hydrate!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连 体感 -8℃，风力 3级。寒风凛冽，裹紧衣服，小心感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -8℃ with 3-level wind. It's biting cold, bundle up to avoid catching a cold.
